notes.title: Update Notes for September 24th (v1.0.2)
notes.content: [p]I'm impressed by many of the highscores that you all have been getting. Thank you for playing![/p][p][/p][p]Here are some minor changes we have made in the latest update:[/p][p][/p][p]Improvements:[/p][p]- When building high up, the camera will now stay in place when starting climbing with space or the start button. Press any of the movement keys to immediately get to Bob.[/p][p]- A smooth camera transition when changing between building to climbing.[/p][p][/p][p]Bugs:[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where going between build and climb hundreds of times in the same level could crash the game.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with the background music not changing in the sandbox.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: - When building high up, the camera will now stay in place when starting climbing with space or the start button. Press any of the movement keys to immediately get to Bob.
- A smooth camera transition when changing between building to climbing.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where going between build and climb hundreds of times in the same level could crash the game.
- Fixed an issue with the background music not changing in the sandbox.

notes.title: Update Notes for August 28th (v1.0.1)
notes.content:
Thank you to everybody that has been playing the game and providing valuable feedback!

Here are some minor changes we have made in the latest update:
- Added an option for display resolutions to the settings menu
- Fixed an issue with moving the camera for resolution aspect ratios other than 16:9
- Fixed an issue with leaderboards not loading in some cases

tags.feature: - Added an option for display resolutions to the settings menu

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue with moving the camera for resolution aspect ratios other than 16:9
- Fixed an issue with leaderboards not loading in some cases

notes.title: Save and Load level solutions!
notes.content:
[p]In the latest updated we added a feature that will save your best solution for each level. [/p][p]When finishing a level, a new menu is shown on the left side. You can go back to load your three most recent solutions and your best solution for that level.[/p][p]Using the copy icon, you can get a shareable code that you can share with other players.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, we have also fixed some bugs. Thank your for all your reports![/p][p]- Game will no longer crash or spawn extra Bobs when spamming start/restart
- Fixed an issue that could cause two blocks to be picked up with the same click and get stuck
- The building collapsed popup will no longer appear when putting blocks under the floor
- Fixed some leaderboard shenanigans[/p]

tags.feature: In the latest updated we added a feature that will save your best solution for each level.
When finishing a level, a new menu is shown on the left side. You can go back to load your three most recent solutions and your best solution for that level.
Using the copy icon, you can get a shareable code that you can share with other players.

tags.bug: - Game will no longer crash or spawn extra Bobs when spamming start/restart
- Fixed an issue that could cause two blocks to be picked up with the same click and get stuck
- The building collapsed popup will no longer appear when putting blocks under the floor
